project.name: analyze
project.description: Django-style library management app with loans, holds, fees, reports and library info modules, using repository/service/composition layering and HTML templates.

layers.name: Web Layer
layers.description: Django views, URL routing, forms and view helpers handling HTTP requests.

layers.name: Templates
layers.description: HTML templates rendering the user interface.

layers.name: Service Layer
layers.description: Business logic for loans, holds and fees, with clock and payment gateway abstractions.

layers.name: Data Access Layer
layers.description: Models, repositories, migrations and database core.

layers.name: Composition Layer
layers.description: Wiring of repositories and services into ready-to-use objects.

layers.name: Package Structure and Commands
layers.description: Package init files and management commands such as the monthly report.

tour.title: Project Entry Structure
tour.description: The project is a Django-style library app split into feature packages (loans, holds, fees, reports, library_info) under src/, with shared templates in templates/. The src package and the core database helper are the shared foundation.

tour.title: Library Info: The Simplest App
tour.description: library_info shows the app's URL-to-view pattern: urls.py maps routes to GET-only views that render a styled about page or a legacy unstyled one.

tour.title: Shared Template Layout
tour.description: base.html provides the navigation and styling (DaisyUI/Tailwind, HTMX) that full pages extend.

tour.title: Loans: Routing and Views
tour.description: Loans is the core feature. urls.py defines JSON/text endpoints and UI pages; views.py handles HTTP and delegates to the application layer.

tour.title: Loans: Domain Services
tour.description: services.py holds framework-independent use cases (lend, return, look up) built on domain records and ports, keeping business rules testable without Django.

tour.title: Loans: Adapters and Wiring
tour.description: The repository and clock adapters implement the service ports; composition.py is the composition root wiring them together. models.py is the ORM model with due-date logic and migrations create the table.

tour.title: Loans: HTMX UI Partials
tour.description: Loan pages use HTMX partials for the form, creation confirmation and return status, swapped in without full reloads.

tour.title: Holds: Same Architecture, Different Domain
tour.description: Holds repeat the pattern: urls, views, services, ORM repository, clock, model, composition root and an initial migration.

tour.title: Fees: Late Fees and Payments
tour.description: Fees compute late fees from loans via a read-only loan repository and charge through an HTTP payment gateway adapter; view helpers format amounts and handle gateway results.

tour.title: Fees: UI Templates
